name: @borecount/fastify-routes
description: Fastify route registration package for Borecount HTTP routes.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --packages=external --root=src --outdir=dist && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-relative-imports.mjs packages/fastify-routes/dist
